title: ext.credleak of AER records written by the credleak.cell mapper (C.10; D.19.3; closed member list)
description: Verbatim cell and run fields without a core slot. Values copied from the source are untrusted, open JSON; the member names are closed. Not a published corpus schema in v0.1 (AD-10 row 13).

run_index.description: execution: the run's 0-based index in runs[]

path_facets.description: execution: the cell path's facets (D.19.1); never identity

run_duration_ms.description: execution: runs[i].durationMs verbatim (no clock; never a time)

cell_run_id.description: execution: the cell's runId verbatim (a batch id shared by several cells; never identity or a time)

cell_timestamp.description: execution: the cell's timestamp verbatim (never a time)

config.description: execution: the cell's config verbatim (judge and embedder labels, thresholds, maxTurns)

cell_summary.description: execution: the cell's summary verbatim (the harness's per-cell aggregates)

run_fields.description: execution: every other run field verbatim (signals not judged, errorDetail, intentVerdicts, toolCallCount, ...)

duration_ms.description: scope run or agent_invocation, tool_execution: durationMs verbatim (no clock; never a time)

timestamp.description: scope agent_invocation: the turn's timestamp verbatim (role not determinable; never a typed time)

canary_detected.description: scope agent_invocation: the harness detector's canaryDetected verbatim

canaries_found_count.description: scope agent_invocation: the number of canariesFound labels (the labels are not copied, D-264)

canary_in_input.description: tool_execution: the harness detector's canaryInInput verbatim

canary_in_output.description: tool_execution: the harness detector's canaryInOutput verbatim

redacted.description: message (tool result): D-605, the redacted pointers and the profile rule of each, [{p, rule: <profile id>@<version>#<rule id>}]; never the original
